title: wsutil: Add ws_socketpair
description:
Recent Windows (all we support) has support for AF_UNIX, but doesn't
have socketpair(). Windows also doesn't allow select() on pipes, only
on sockets. For asynchronous processing, libssh provides only a wrapper
around select(). So:

Provide ws_socketpair(), which is a wrapper around socketpair() where
we have it on POSIX systems, and implements it using AF_UNIX sockets
on Windows, using a temporary filename in the temporary directory with
a name derived from a generated UUID, and the filename deleted
immediately after the connection.

Ping #14239, #17131

https://devblogs.microsoft.com/commandline/af_unix-comes-to-windows/

changes_data.diff:
@@ -85,6 +85,21 @@ WS_DLL_PUBLIC int ws_socket_ptoa(struct sockaddr_storage *dst, const char *src,
  */
 WS_DLL_PUBLIC bool ws_verify_peercred(socket_handle_t sock);
 
+/**
+ * @brief Creates an unbound pair of AF_UNIX sockets of a specified type.
+ *
+ * Calls socketpair(AF_UNIX, type, 0, sv[0]) on systems that have it
+ * (POSIX), and implements it on those that don't.
+ *
+ * @note Windows only supports SOCK_STREAM type sockets with AF_UNIX, so only
+ * that has cross-platform support currently.
+ *
+ * @param type The type of socket, optionally ORd with flags.
+ * @param sv Socket vector to hold the created socket pair
+ * @return 0 on success, -1 otherwise with errno/last-error set.
+ */
+WS_DLL_PUBLIC int ws_socketpair(int type, socket_handle_t sv[2]);
+
 #ifdef	__cplusplus
 }
 #endif
